step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents the infrastructure for myequifax.com. Users access the platform via web or mobile devices through an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB routes incoming consumer requests to an EKS compute cluster composed of EC2 On-Demand instances (40%) and EC2 Spot instances (60%) for cost optimization. Applications running on the compute nodes interact with Amazon Aurora Global Database for ACID-compliant transactional relational storage (PostgreSQL) and with a Document Storage (DocumentDB/NoSQL) system for credit documents and unstructured data.
